title: A refund request does not yet reverse a captured amount
method: Synthetic order value is 120 currency units. Net captured amount = confirmed captures minus confirmed refunds. A pending refund is not subtracted until confirmed. Fees, settlement timing, partial refunds and exchange rates are excluded; this is not customer evidence.
alt: A refund request does not yet reverse a captured amount. Inventory reserved: 0 currency units net captured; Payment captured: 120 currency units net captured; Refund pending: 120 currency units net captured; Refund confirmed: 0 currency units net captured. Illustrative values.
